record.original_question: Let ∞ X f (z) = an k z n k k=1 be analytic in D and have Hadamard gaps. Characterise sets S in D with the property that if f is bounded on S then f (z) is bounded for z ∈ D. (K. G. Binmore)

evidence.quote: Let ∞ X f (z) = an k z n k k=1 be analytic in D and have Hadamard gaps. Characterise sets S in D with the property that if f is bounded on S then f (z) is bounded for z ∈ D. (K. G. Binmore)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$ denote the open unit disc. Consider a power series
$$f(z) = \sum_{k=1}^{\infty} a_{n_k} z^{n_k}$$
which is analytic in $\mathbb{D}$ and has Hadamard gaps, meaning that the sequence of exponents $\{n_k\}_{k=1}^\infty$ satisfies $n_{k+1}/n_k \geq q$ for all $k$ and some fixed constant $q > 1$.

Give a characterisation of those subsets $S \subseteq \mathbb{D}$ with the following property: whenever $f$ is bounded on $S$ (i.e., $\sup_{z \in S} |f(z)| < \infty$), the function $f$ is necessarily bounded on the entire disc $\mathbb{D}$.
artifact.category_tag: Hadamard gap series in the unit disc
artifact.status_search_result: Searches reveal extensive related literature on boundary behaviour of Hadamard gap series in the unit disc (e.g. work of Binmore–Hornblower in Nagoya Math. J. 48, 1972, and subsequent studies in weighted/growth spaces), but no source explicitly states a complete characterisation of subsets S ⊂ 𝔻 on which boundedness of every Hadamard-gap analytic function forces boundedness in 𝔻. The status of the original problem appears unresolved by these searches.

status_evidence.title: Boundary Behaviour of Functions With Hadamard Gaps (Binmore–Hornblower)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies boundary behaviour of functions analytic in the unit disc with Hadamard gaps, but does not provide a complete characterisation of sets S on which boundedness forces global boundedness.
status_evidence.claim: Related work by Binmore and Hornblower addresses boundary behaviour, but not the precise characterisation requested.

status_evidence.title: Hadamard gap series in growth spaces (Collectanea Math.)
status_evidence.snippet: Treats Hadamard gap series in weighted growth spaces on the disc.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent literature investigates Hadamard gap series in various function spaces, without resolving the stated characterisation problem.
